name: n8n-nodes-freesdn
description: n8n community nodes for FreeSDN network management platform

dependencyHolds.n8n-workflow: Use the upstream stable channel (2.46.5 on 2026-11-11). The latest dist-tag points to the older 2.16.0 release, while beta is 2.48.0. Do not downgrade or adopt beta based only on the latest tag. Keep this exact pin: a caret also admits the beta-tagged 2.48.0 because upstream does not use a semver prerelease suffix.
dependencyHolds.@types/node: Track Node 24 LTS APIs to match the public-release Docker builder and CI. Adopt a newer major only after it enters LTS and FreeSDN qualifies that migration.
